english.title: Promote, publish or print multiple sheet document re:election candidate without printer/publisher details
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), and which was published in a document other than one which consisted of, or principally consisted of, a single side of printed matter]_
(B)_[publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), and was in a document other than one which consisted of, or principally consisted of, a single side of printed matter]_
(C)_[printer of a document other than one which consisted of, or principally consisted of, a single side of printed matter and which contained material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),]_

when the name and address of

(D)_[the printer of the document]_
(E)_[the promoter of the material]_
(F)_[a person on behalf of whom the material was being published]_
(G)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_

did not appear on the first or the last page of that document
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(a), (5) and (9) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the promoter/publisher/printer of material
which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate at an election
and which was published in a document other than one which consisted of, or principally consisted of, a single side of printed matter
when the name and address of the printer of the document, the promoter of the material or a person on behalf of whom the material was being published
did not appear on the first or the last page of that document

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
